qualification_components.title: Planning, Design & Installation of electrical sub system

performance_criteria.description: Communicate with the supervisor to understand the day's production requirements and plan work.
Apply approved drawings, job instructions or work manuals.
Collect required consumables, including wires and connectors.
Collect the work manual or job instruction from the manager.
Visually inspect boards and components for physical damage, loose connections or incorrect connections.
Follow the standard operating procedure to assemble the electrical subsystem.
Accurately interpret drawings, wiring and job specifications or instructions.
Identify and mark errors found in a previous assembly step.
Report defective components or an inadequate number of components.
Report insufficient consumables, such as wires, connectors, screws and nuts.

qualification_components.title: Testing, Commissioning, Maintenance, Fault Finding & Repair

performance_criteria.description: Test installations before energizing, including insulation resistance, earth continuity, polarity and visual inspection, to support personal and electrical safety.
Test energized installations for correct operation, including voltage, phase rotation and protection-device functioning.
Set up equipment and configure programmable relays, bus systems, timers and overload relays; load required applications and configure systems such as KNX, DALI, Modbus and IP- or IT-based systems.
Set the installation to full working condition and ensure the customer can operate it.
Adapt to changing circumstances.

Troubleshoot installation faults, including short or open circuits, incorrect polarity, insulation-resistance or earth-continuity faults, incorrect equipment settings and incorrect programmable-device settings.
Diagnose installation problems, including bad connections, incorrect wiring, high loop impedance and equipment failure.
Verify that an existing electrical installation continues to meet applicable current standards.
Use, test and calibrate measuring equipment, including insulation-resistance, continuity, installation, multimeter, clamp and network-cable testers.
Repair or replace faulty components in electrical installations.
Rewire and repair faulty installations.
Identify employability skills required for jobs across industries.
Identify and explore learning and employability portals.
Recognize constitutional values, civic rights and duties, citizenship, social responsibility, and personal ethics.
Follow environmentally sustainable practices.
Recognize the importance of 21st-century skills for employment.
Practise self-awareness, behaviour skills, time management, critical and adaptive thinking, problem-solving, creativity, social and cultural awareness, emotional awareness and continuous learning.
Use basic English in everyday conversations, in person and over the telephone.
Read and understand routine information and instructions written in English.
Write short messages, notes, letters and emails in English.
Understand the difference between a job and a career.
Prepare a career development plan with short- and long-term goals based on aptitude.
Follow verbal and non-verbal communication etiquette and active-listening techniques.
Work collaboratively with others in a team.
Communicate and behave appropriately with people of all genders and persons with disabilities.
Escalate workplace sexual-harassment issues according to the POSH Act.
Select financial institutions, products and services according to requirements.
Carry out offline and online financial transactions safely and securely.
Identify salary components and calculate income, expenses, taxes and investments.
Identify relevant rights and laws and use legal aid to address legal exploitation.
Operate digital devices and perform basic internet operations securely.
Use email, social media and virtual collaboration tools effectively.
Use basic features of word-processing, spreadsheet and presentation software.
Identify types of entrepreneurship and enterprises and research potential business opportunities.
Develop a business plan and work model using the 4Ps: Product, Price, Place and Promotion.
Identify funding sources and anticipate or mitigate financial and legal barriers to a business opportunity.
Identify different types of customers.
Identify and respond professionally to customer requests and needs.
Follow appropriate hygiene and grooming standards.
Create a professional curriculum vitae or résumé.
Search for suitable jobs using reliable offline and online sources.
Apply for identified job openings using suitable offline or online methods.
Answer recruitment and selection questions politely, clearly and confidently.
Identify apprenticeship opportunities and register according to applicable guidelines and requirements.

qualification_components.title: Apply health and safety practices at the workplace

performance_criteria.description: Identify workplace hazards and possible causes of accidents.
Follow organizational safe-working practices and observe hazard signs in work areas.
Use appropriate personal protective equipment for the task, working conditions and hazard severity.
Follow safety procedures when handling tools, equipment and hazardous substances or working in hazardous environments.
Dispose of electronic waste using industry-approved techniques.
Prevent component damage by following electrostatic-discharge procedures.
Locate workplace health and safety equipment, including fire extinguishers, first-aid equipment, safety equipment and fire exits.
Maintain appropriate posture when handling heavy objects.
Apply good housekeeping practices.
Take preventive measures to avoid fire hazards.
Use appropriate fire extinguishers for different types of fires.
Demonstrate rescue and first-aid techniques in cases of fire or electrocution.
Provide appropriate first aid for bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock and poisoning.
Provide first aid in cases of heart attack or cardiac arrest due to electric shock.
Follow emergency procedures, including raising alarms, evacuation, taking shelter, reaching assembly points, roll call and safe return to work.
Use the correct method to move injured people during an emergency.
Identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste.
Segregate waste into appropriate categories.
Ensure appropriate disposal of non-recyclable waste.
Deposit materials for disposal or reuse at identified locations, as described in the qualification file.
Follow specified processes for hazardous-waste disposal.
